title: Event envelope
description: CloudEvents 1.0 in structured JSON mode. Every Capricorn event uses this envelope; `data` is validated against the schema named by `type`.

id.description: Unique per event. Consumers use it to process each event once.

source.description: The component that produced the event.

type.description: Event name and version, for example session.ended.v1.

subject.description: ID of the thing the event is about (a session, device or family).
